units.source_text: ”僧都说：“你年纪轻轻，来日方长，为什么决心要出家呢？

en.t: The Sozu said, "You are still young, with a long life ahead of you. Why have you resolved to become a nun?

units.source_text: 此事反会使你身蒙罪障。

en.t: This may instead burden you with sin and karmic hindrance.

units.source_text: 因为发心出家之时，固然自觉道心坚强，然而经过若干年月之后，为女子者不免意志懈怠。”

en.t: When one first resolves to renounce the world, one naturally feels firm in religious devotion, but after some years have passed, a woman may well find her will growing slack."

units.source_text: 浮舟答道：“我从小就是个多愁多恨的苦命人。

en.t: Ukifune answered, "Since childhood I have been an unfortunate person, full of sorrow and resentment.

units.source_text: 母亲等也曾说过：‘不如让她出家为尼吧。’

en.t: My mother and others once said, 'It would be better to let her become a nun.'

units.source_text: 到了知识稍开之后，更是厌恶世俗生活，一心只想为后世修福。

en.t: After I became somewhat aware of things, I came to loathe worldly life even more and thought only of cultivating merit for the life to come.

units.source_text: 恐是我的死期渐渐迫近之故，近来常觉精神非常衰弱。

en.t: Perhaps because the time of my death is gradually drawing near, lately I often feel terribly weak in spirit.
I beg you, Sozu, to kindly grant my request."

units.source_text: 如此容貌美丽的一个少女，为什么怀着厌世之心？

en.t: Why should a young woman of such beauty harbor a desire to leave the world?

units.source_text: 那天我所镇伏的鬼怪，也曾说她厌世。

en.t: The spirit I subdued that day also said that she was weary of the world.

units.source_text: 如此想来，此人确有出家的因缘吧。

en.t: Thinking of it this way, she must indeed have a karmic connection with renunciation.

units.source_text: 此人若非禳解，恐怕活不到今天。

en.t: Had she not been ritually purified and protected, she probably would not have lived until today.

units.source_text: 一度被鬼怪所缠的人，若不出家，深恐以后更有可怕可危之事。”

en.t: Once a person has been possessed by a spirit, if she does not renounce the world, I greatly fear that even more dreadful and dangerous things may happen later."

units.source_text: 便对她说：“不论情由如何，凡决心出家，皈依三宝，

en.t: He then said to her, "Whatever the circumstances may be, for anyone to resolve to leave the world and take refuge in the Three Treasures

units.source_text: 总是诸佛菩萨所赞善的事。

en.t: is always something praised as good by all Buddhas and bodhisattvas.

units.source_text: 我乃法师之身，当然绝不反对。

en.t: As I am a Buddhist priest, of course I would never oppose it.

units.source_text: 惟授戒之事，必须从容举行。

en.t: However, the conferring of the precepts must be carried out at a proper and unhurried time.
